sourceRefs.description: Source receipts. Workbench model context supports soha://session/<sessionId>/message/<messageId> and rechecks current ownership and source access. Unsupported historical references remain stored but are withheld from model context.

syncStatus.description: Server-owned synchronization state; omitted on legacy records.

quarantined.description: Server-owned quarantine projection; absent or false means normal. Quarantined records retain their actual status and have syncStatus disabled. Client overrides are ignored.

quarantineReason.description: Safe server-owned reason code; excludes errors, addresses and fact contents. Client overrides are ignored.

sourceHashes.description: Server-generated source receipt URI to lowercase SHA256 of authorized source content; never trust client hashes.
